regulations.notes: The Catskills STR market spans multiple counties (Sullivan, Delaware, Ulster, Greene). Regulation is at the town level — rules vary significantly. NY State STR law S.885C/A.4130C (signed Dec 2024) will create a statewide registration requirement. Some towns have moratoria while others are permissive. NY state lodging taxes apply.
